_about.purpose: tasks of EnterpriseOps-Gym (public oracle split) suited to testing policy compliance, per domain
_about.rule: policy tasks (at least one check whose expected state depends on a system-prompt rule: a guard or a policy-derived value) minus tasks where a reader flagged a contradiction (two checks cannot both pass, or passing requires breaking policy)
_about.source: policy_conformance_tasks.json; method and limits in policy_conformance_review.md
caveats: tags and contradiction flags come from an LLM reading of prompt, request and verifier SQL; all three policy lists have had a baseline run and review (see run_review*); all three control lists have had a baseline run and review
selection read the verifiers: use these lists to select and score tasks, not to design prompts or rules

7 tasks (numeric_text_fixed; 3 CSM policy tasks, 3 CSM and 1 HR non-policy tasks) had integer expected values stored as text; corrected in tasks/verifier_revisions.json, which eog_env.load_task applies on top of the unchanged oracle files, so the plain passed score is valid for them (differs from the upstream data)

control tasks carry the same policy text as policy tasks; the grader does not test it there. A drop on a control task can also mean the approach refused something the policy forbids while a check expects it: investigate before calling it harm

fields.refusal: subset of selected where a requested action must be refused (all or part)
fields.tasks: per selected task: type, guard and policy-derived check positions, rules tested, notes; readmitted and unclear_checks on the 9 tasks put back; baseline_run: passed = passed in the reviewed baseline run, failed_fair = failed and the failed checks were judged fair
fields.excluded: policy tasks left out, with reason: checks_cannot_both_pass, passing_breaks_policy, login_rejected, unstated_exact_text, unstated_action, unstated_value, check_against_request or doubtful_check
fields.smoke: 3 tasks per domain for a quick end-to-end check: one refusal task and two policy-derived tasks on different rules, chosen among the smallest clean tasks (2-5 checks, 4-7 tools, no unclear or same-name checks, not readmitted)
fields.control: task ids of the control list
fields.control_tasks: per control task: type (request_only or request_constraint), number of checks, notes; baseline_run: passed or failed_fair
fields.control_excluded: non-policy tasks left out, with reason: contradiction or unclear_check_risky (before a run), or the run-review reasons used for policy tasks (after a run)

_about.control: 2026-11-23: control lists for a no-harm check. A control task is a task of the same domain where no check depends on a system-prompt rule (every check verifies what the request states, or a condition the request itself sets). Rule: such a task is selected unless a reader flagged a contradiction (a check against the policy or against another check) or it has an unclear check that does not already pass on the untouched seed database. All verifier queries of these tasks ran without error on fresh databases, and no task passes before the agent acts.
